source.author: project
source.documentTitle: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information security, cybersecurity and privacy protection — Information security management systems — Requirements (Annex A control IDs and titles; descriptions written by the project)

requirements.title: Policies for information security
requirements.description: Set out management's direction for security in approved policies that staff and relevant outside parties know about and that are kept up to date.

requirements.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
requirements.description: Decide who is responsible for each part of information security and record those duties so nothing falls between people.

requirements.title: Segregation of duties
requirements.description: Split conflicting duties between different people so one person cannot misuse or hide a mistake in a sensitive process.

requirements.title: Management responsibilities
requirements.description: Managers make sure their staff follow the organization's security policies and procedures in their day-to-day work.

requirements.title: Contact with authorities
requirements.description: Keep working contacts with regulators, law enforcement and other authorities so you can reach them quickly when needed.

requirements.title: Contact with special interest groups
requirements.description: Stay in touch with security forums and professional groups to share knowledge and hear early about new threats.

requirements.title: Threat intelligence
requirements.description: Gather and analyse information about threats so the organization can act on it before or while attacks happen.

requirements.title: Information security in project management
requirements.description: Build security into every project from the start, whatever kind of project it is, rather than adding it at the end.

requirements.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
requirements.description: Keep an up-to-date list of information and related assets, each with a named owner responsible for it.

requirements.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
requirements.description: Write down and communicate the rules for how people may use and handle information and the assets that hold it.

requirements.title: Return of assets
requirements.description: Get back the organization's equipment and information from staff and outside parties when their job or contract ends.

requirements.title: Classification of information
requirements.description: Sort information into protection levels based on how sensitive it is and what the business and law require.

requirements.title: Labelling of information
requirements.description: Mark information with its classification so everyone handling it knows how much protection it needs.

requirements.title: Information transfer
requirements.description: Protect information whenever it moves, inside the organization or to others, by any channel or medium.

requirements.title: Access control
requirements.description: Set and enforce rules for who may reach information and systems, based on business and security needs.

requirements.title: Identity management
requirements.description: Manage each identity through its whole life so every person and system that gets access is uniquely known.

requirements.title: Authentication information
requirements.description: Control how passwords, keys and other secrets that prove identity are issued, used and looked after.

requirements.title: Access rights
requirements.description: Grant, review, change and remove access rights in line with the access rules and each person's current role.

requirements.title: Information security in supplier relationships
requirements.description: Agree how to manage the security risks that come from using suppliers' products and services.

requirements.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
requirements.description: Write the security requirements that matter for each supplier into the agreement with that supplier.

requirements.title: Managing information security in the information and communication technology (ICT) supply chain
requirements.description: Handle the security risks of the technology supply chain, including the suppliers' own suppliers.

requirements.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
requirements.description: Watch how suppliers deliver, review their security regularly and manage changes to the services they provide.

requirements.title: Information security for use of cloud services
requirements.description: Set how cloud services are chosen, used, managed and left, in line with the organization's security needs.

requirements.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
requirements.description: Plan ahead for security incidents: roles, procedures and tools ready before anything goes wrong.

requirements.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
requirements.description: Look at each security event and decide whether it counts as an incident that needs a response.

requirements.title: Response to information security incidents
requirements.description: Respond to security incidents by following the documented procedures, from containment to closure.

requirements.title: Learning from information security incidents
requirements.description: Use what was learned from past incidents to strengthen controls and lower the chance of a repeat.

requirements.title: Collection of evidence
requirements.description: Identify, collect and keep evidence about security events in a way that will stand up if it is needed later.

requirements.title: Information security during disruption
requirements.description: Keep information protected at the right level while the organization is dealing with a disruption.

requirements.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
requirements.description: Make sure technology can be recovered in time to meet the organization's business continuity goals.

requirements.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
requirements.description: Know the legal, regulatory and contract obligations that affect security, and how the organization meets them.

requirements.title: Intellectual property rights
requirements.description: Follow procedures that respect intellectual property, such as software licences and copyrighted material.

requirements.title: Protection of records
requirements.description: Keep records safe from loss, destruction, tampering, unauthorized access and unauthorized release.

requirements.title: Privacy and protection of personal identifiable information (PII)
requirements.description: Meet the privacy and personal data protection requirements that apply under law, regulation and contracts.

requirements.title: Independent review of information security
requirements.description: Have the security approach and its implementation reviewed independently at planned times or after major changes.

requirements.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
requirements.description: Check regularly that the organization actually follows its own security policies, rules and standards.

requirements.title: Documented operating procedures
requirements.description: Write down operating procedures for information processing facilities and make them available to those who need them.

requirements.title: Screening
requirements.description: Check the background of candidates before they join, in proportion to the role, the risks and the law.

requirements.title: Terms and conditions of employment
requirements.description: State the security duties of staff and of the organization in employment contracts and terms.

requirements.title: Information security awareness, education and training
requirements.description: Give staff the security awareness and training their role needs, and refresh it as policies change.

requirements.title: Disciplinary process
requirements.description: Have a formal, communicated process for acting when someone breaks the security policy.

requirements.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
requirements.description: Spell out which security duties still apply after someone leaves or changes role, and enforce them.

requirements.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
requirements.description: Use confidentiality agreements that reflect what must be protected, and review and sign them as needed.

requirements.title: Remote working
requirements.description: Put security measures in place for people working away from the organization's premises.

requirements.title: Information security event reporting
requirements.description: Give people a quick, clear way to report security events they notice, and encourage them to use it.

requirements.title: Physical security perimeters
requirements.description: Define and protect the boundaries of areas that hold information and the facilities that process it.

requirements.title: Physical entry
requirements.description: Protect secure areas with entry controls and access points so only authorized people get in.

requirements.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
requirements.description: Design and apply physical protection for offices, rooms and other facilities.

requirements.title: Physical security monitoring
requirements.description: Watch premises continuously to detect anyone getting in who should not be there.

requirements.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
requirements.description: Design protection against fire, flood, power problems and other physical or environmental threats.

requirements.title: Working in secure areas
requirements.description: Set rules for how people work inside secure areas so the protection is not undermined.

requirements.title: Clear desk and clear screen
requirements.description: Keep papers and removable media off desks and screens locked when unattended, so information is not exposed.

requirements.title: Equipment siting and protection
requirements.description: Place and protect equipment so it is safe from physical harm and from people who should not see or touch it.

requirements.title: Security of assets off-premises
requirements.description: Protect equipment and information that is used or kept outside the organization's premises.

requirements.title: Storage media
requirements.description: Manage storage media through its whole life: acquisition, use, transport and disposal, by its classification.

requirements.title: Supporting utilities
requirements.description: Protect processing facilities from failures and disruptions of power, cooling and other supporting utilities.

requirements.title: Cabling security
requirements.description: Protect power and data cables from interception, interference and damage.

requirements.title: Equipment maintenance
requirements.description: Maintain equipment properly so information stays available, intact and confidential.

requirements.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
requirements.description: Remove sensitive data and licensed software from equipment before it is disposed of or reused.

requirements.title: User end point devices
requirements.description: Protect information that is stored on, processed by or reachable from laptops, phones and other user devices.

requirements.title: Privileged access rights
requirements.description: Limit and closely manage who gets privileged access, and how such access is granted and used.

requirements.title: Information access restriction
requirements.description: Restrict access to information and application functions in line with the access control rules.

requirements.title: Access to source code
requirements.description: Control who can read and change source code, development tools and software libraries.

requirements.title: Secure authentication
requirements.description: Use authentication technology and procedures that fit the access rules and how sensitive the information is.

requirements.title: Capacity management
requirements.description: Watch how resources are used and plan capacity so systems keep performing as demand grows.

requirements.title: Protection against malware
requirements.description: Defend against malware with technical measures backed up by user awareness.

requirements.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
requirements.description: Find out about technical weaknesses in systems in use, judge the exposure and act on them in time.

requirements.title: Configuration management
requirements.description: Set, record, apply, monitor and review secure configurations for hardware, software, services and networks.

requirements.title: Information deletion
requirements.description: Delete information from systems and devices once it is no longer needed.

requirements.title: Data masking
requirements.description: Hide or mask data, such as personal data, where the access rules, business needs or law require it.

requirements.title: Data leakage prevention
requirements.description: Apply measures to systems, networks and devices that detect and stop sensitive information from leaking out.

requirements.title: Information backup
requirements.description: Keep backup copies of information, software and systems and test them, in line with an agreed backup policy.

requirements.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
requirements.description: Build in enough duplicate processing capacity to meet the organization's availability needs.

requirements.title: Logging
requirements.description: Record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events in logs, and protect and analyse those logs.

requirements.title: Monitoring activities
requirements.description: Watch networks, systems and applications for unusual behaviour and act on possible security incidents.

requirements.title: Clock synchronization
requirements.description: Keep the clocks of all systems in step with an approved time source so events can be correlated.

requirements.title: Use of privileged utility programs
requirements.description: Restrict and tightly control programs that can override system and application controls.

requirements.title: Installation of software on operational systems
requirements.description: Manage how software gets installed on live systems so only approved software runs there.

requirements.title: Networks security
requirements.description: Secure, manage and control networks and network devices to protect the information in systems and applications.

requirements.title: Security of network services
requirements.description: Identify, put in place and monitor the security features and service levels of network services.

requirements.title: Segregation of networks
requirements.description: Separate groups of information services, users and systems into their own network segments.

requirements.title: Web filtering
requirements.description: Manage access to external websites to cut exposure to malicious content.

requirements.title: Use of cryptography
requirements.description: Set and follow rules for using cryptography well, including how cryptographic keys are managed.

requirements.title: Secure development life cycle
requirements.description: Set and apply rules for building software and systems securely throughout development.

requirements.title: Application security requirements
requirements.description: Identify, specify and approve security requirements when building or buying applications.

requirements.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
requirements.description: Define, document and apply principles for engineering secure systems, and keep them current.

requirements.title: Secure coding
requirements.description: Apply secure coding principles when writing software.

requirements.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
requirements.description: Define and carry out security testing during development and before systems are accepted.

requirements.title: Outsourced development
requirements.description: Direct, monitor and review development work done by outside parties.

requirements.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
requirements.description: Keep development, test and live environments apart and secure each of them.

requirements.title: Change management
requirements.description: Run changes to systems and processing facilities through a change management process.

requirements.title: Test information
requirements.description: Choose, protect and manage the information used for testing with proper care.

requirements.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
requirements.description: Plan and agree audit tests on live systems with management so they do not disrupt the business.
